g.text: A little frogman swings a big net at a toad, and misses by a mile.
Not well. The slugs have got into the patches lately. Young Nib has a plan that might just work, so he's
gone to catch some toads. You can ask him about it if you like, he's near the water to the east.
The smell of rain drifts from Frogman's pipe.
A little frogman swings a big net at a toad, and misses by a mile. The toad doesn't even blink.
